title: Understanding Variance
text: Variance measures how much the values in a dataset differ from the mean. If the values are spread out, the variance is larger. Consider how combining datasets might affect this spread.

title: Effect of Combining Data
text: When you combine datasets, think about how the overall spread of data points around the mean might change. Does combining increase or decrease the spread?
